tenderSchedule.title: Construction of a Compound Wall and Concrete Road, along with Building Repair and Electrification Works, at the Government Cocoon Market, Srinivaspura, Kolar District.
tenderSchedule.locationName: SD Engineering Cell Division No ONE Bengaluru

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

Achieved in at least Two Financial year a minimum financial turnover (Civil contracts works only) of Rs.48.42 Lakhs (usually not less than the amount put to tender under this contract for works costing upto and Rs.100 lakhs).
Mandating satisfactory completion as prime contractor for at least one similar work of value not less than Rs.12.10 Lakhs (usually not less than 50% of the amount put to tender).

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Banker Details for reference
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded

Proposals for subcontracting components of works amounting to more than 20% of the contract price (for each, the qualifications and experience of the identified sub-contractor in the relevant fields should be attached)

if any, additional information is required, the same may be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer, No.1 Division, DOS Bangalore, during office hours on all working days. It may be noted that if any of the dates mentioned above happen to be a General Holiday, the next working day will be considered
The Tender processing fee shall not be refundable.

All the work as maintained in the Bill of Quantity (BOQ) includes lead and lift charges, loading and unloading charges, labour charges, all incidental charges, hire charges of all machinery and equipment required for successful completion of work etc., complete. The work shall be executed as per the standard technical specification and directions of the Engineer in charge of the work
Conditional bids will be rejected
Tender who qualify in the technical bid such tender financial bid will be opened
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per the prevailing Govt orders.

The tender shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those cost. The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing kppp - Portal.

Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading & unloading charges, hire charges of all machinery and equipment, and all other incidental charges. The work shall be carried out as per standard technical detailed specifications and as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.
Materials like bitumen, steel, cement etc., required for the work shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should be tested by the quality control authority before use on the work

Incresed in GST Shall not be paid in the extended period at the contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for the delay, as determined by the authority, while granting an extension of time.GST Shall be paid separately.
All other conditions are remained same as Bid Document
